intended_object: The functor from the category of commutative groups to the category of additive commutative groups that sends a group X to its additive version `Additive X` and acts on morphisms via `MonoidHom.toAdditive`. Inferred from the docstring and the module, which builds the equivalence CommGrpCat ≌ AddCommGrpCat.
explanation: This functor is faithful to its docstring. On objects it sends X to the bundled additive commutative group `Additive X`. On morphisms it sends f to `f.hom.toAdditive`, the same underlying map regarded as an additive homomorphism. `Additive` and `MonoidHom.toAdditive` are definitional relabellings, so the functor laws hold by `rfl`, and the functor is one half of the standard equivalence between multiplicative and additive commutative groups. It is a particular functor between two particular categories, and the corresponding functor for groups that need not be commutative is a separate declaration (`GrpCat.toAddGrp`). So there is no broader setting in which this definition should have been stated, and it is not too narrow.
